title: Kammler's flying saucer work and Die Glocke

tellings.quote: And right there in Czechoslovakia in modern day Poland is this thing called Commto where Hans Conler, the most ruthless Nazi who was doing the most kind of black world technology projects, was rumored to be working on flying saucers

plain: At a site in what was then Czechoslovakia, now part of Poland, the Nazi official Hans Kammler was rumoured to be building flying saucers. Michels calls Kammler the most ruthless Nazi, the man running the most secret technology projects, and names the site as "Commto". The story is tied to Die Glocke, German for "the Bell", a secret Nazi device people talk about. Michels tells it himself as a rumour, without naming a source.
